items.whyInNews: On 23 August 2026 Czech players Marta Muchova and Jan Mensik clinched the mixed doubles championship at the U.S. Open in New York, defeating the Australian pair in the final.
items.summary: Marta Muchova and Jan Mensik of the Czech Republic won the mixed doubles title at the U.S. Open on 23 August 2026 in New York City, United States, beating the Australian duo 6‑4, 7‑5 in the final. The tournament featured a revamped mixed‑doubles format in its second year, aiming to attract top singles players. Their victory marks the first Grand Slam mixed‑doubles title for both players.
keyPoints: Marta Muchova and Jan Mensik won U.S. Open mixed doubles on 23 August 2026 in New York
Czech pair defeated Australian team 6‑4, 7‑5 in the final
Tournament used the second‑year revamped mixed‑doubles format
This is the first Grand Slam mixed‑doubles title for both Czech players
importantPoints: United States Tennis Association (USTA) – founded 1881 – headquarters New York City
Event governed by the International Tennis Federation (ITF) Grand Slam Regulations 2025, Article 5.3 (mixed‑doubles format)
Previous Czech mixed‑doubles Grand Slam champion was Petra Kvitová in 2019 Wimbledon mixed doubles
Czech Republic currently ranked 7th out of 20 nations in the ITF Mixed Doubles Nations Ranking (July 2026)
Victory boosts Czech Republic’s overall medal tally and supports its bid for hosting future ITF events
